20 [[Scale Hide]] | movement speed = | eitr regen = | resistance = * Resistant vs. Frost * Very Weak (2x) vs. Fire | other effect = [[Feather fall]] * Limit fall speed: 5m/s * Fall damage: -100% * Jump stamina: -20% }} }} The '''Eitr-weave Set''' is a [[Mistlands]]-tier [[armor]]. This set is the tier above [[Padded Armor]] and should be considered a "light armor" compared to [[Carapace Armor]] as its armor values are lower while having less movement speed penalty. The armor offers a unique effect per piece that grants [[Eitr]] regeneration, which makes it the preferred armor when using [[magic]] weapons like [[Staff of Embers]]. The Feather cape also offers a unique effect that negates fall damage entirely.
